question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

items.text: Raymond James has signaled it expects continued advisor-recruiting momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year, after ending its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, up 2% year-over-year.
items.quote: the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year
